page_title: CRE 3-2 SAS | Cremonese v Sassuolo 29/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Marco Guida has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+3' 3 - 2 Goal! Manuel De Luca (Cremonese) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Arijanet Muric into middle of the goal.
90+3' Manuel De Luca (Cremonese) is going to take the penalty!
90+2' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Guida interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That is a penalty kick for Cremonese.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Manuel De Luca (Cremonese) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Arijanet Muric.
89' Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
85' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by David Okereke (Cremonese).
82' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanabria will be replaced by Manuel De Luca (Cremonese).
82' Substitution. Romano Floriani (Cremonese) in, Alessio Zerbin out.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nemanja Matic as he is replaced by Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo).
79' The shots on goal statistics – 4:6.
76' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
74' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. David Okereke (Cremonese) replaces Franco Vazquez.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jari Vandeputte leaves the pitch and Martin Payero (Cremonese) comes on.
73' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Emil Audero no chance!
73' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
72' Today's referee Marco Guida rightly decides to book Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) for his harsh tackle.
72' A player from Cremonese pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Sassuolo have been awarded a penalty kick!
69' Substitution. Aster Vranckx is replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
69' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Armand Lauriente is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Bondo departs the field of play to be replaced by Alberto Grassi (Cremonese).
63' 2 - 1 Goal! Cristian Volpato provides Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
58' 8:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
54' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' A header by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Arijanet Muric, who makes a nice save.
46' Fabio Grosso has made a change at the break. Fali Cande has come on in place of Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
46' Half-time substitution. Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) is replaced by Cristian Volpato.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Marco Guida shows the yellow card to Josh Doig (Sassuolo) for a heavy challenge.
43' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort smashes off the crossbar.
43' The ball is out of play. Sassuolo win a corner kick.
43' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Emil Audero to dive and make a save.
41' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
39' 2 - 0 Goal! Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) scores after an assist by Antonio Sanabria that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
37' 1 - 0 Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) gets on the end of the corner and powers a header into the bottom left corner.
37' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
36' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
36' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
33' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
33' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
32' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

31' That didn't go as planned! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Emil Audero, who easily kept it out.
30' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
29' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' Sassuolo are ruled offside.
23' 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
19' The corner is swung in but Cremonese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Marco Guida blows his whistle. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) commits a foul after dangerous play.
14' Marco Guida interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese).
11' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
10' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cremonese are awarded the free kick.
9' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
8' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) for a tough tackle.
5' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
2' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
